title: Configuration-version overlap
objective: Interpret flags/configuration with old/new code; detect divergent meanings of one shared setting.
preconditions: A local browser with JavaScript; no account, server or Azure subscription.
Old and new synthetic readers overlap and receive one retryBudget value.
Approved retries-v1 means extra retries after the first attempt.
actions: Choose schema, raw integer and new-code interpretation.
Inspect both synthetic readers and their attempt-3 journeys.
Attempt publication of that exact inspected draft.
Recover and compare retained failures, or explicitly reset.
assertions: Matching approved semantics and two successful journeys are required to publish.
Divergent meanings block publication even when both journeys succeed.
Unknown evidence and unsupported schemas cannot pass.
Edits invalidate checks; blocked publication preserves the prior value and history.
banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
limits: No network, persistence, real retries, propagation or distributed configuration.
No credentials, authentication, cloud, IaC, registration, deployment or spend.
No native Azure, Node.js 24 production, source-parent or reliability certification.
Refresh or explicit reset clears in-memory evidence; export is not implemented.
